chapter.heading: A Song of Praise to the Lord for His Salvation and JudgmentA Psalm.
chapter.v:
Oh, sing
to the Lord a new song!For He has done marvelous things;His right hand and His holy arm have gained Him the victory. [Deut. 24:1; Jer. 3:8 b Deut. 32:30; 2 Kin. 4:1; Neh. 5:5]

The Lord
has made known His salvation;His righteousness He has revealed in the sight of the nations. [Ps. 106:9; Nah. 1:4]

He has
remembered His mercy and His faithfulness to the house of Israel;All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God. [Ex. 10:21 f Is. 13:10; Rev. 6:12]

Shout joyfully
to the Lord, all the earth;Break forth in song, rejoice, and sing praises. [Ex. 4:11 h Matt.]

Sing to
the Lord with the harp,With the harp and the sound of a psalm, [Ps. 40:6; Is. 35:5 j Matt. 26:39; Mark 14:36; Luke 22:42; John 8:29; Acts 26:19; [Phil. 2:8; Heb. 5:8; 10:7]]

With trumpets
and the sound of a horn;Shout joyfully before the Lord, the King. [Lam. 3:30] [Matt. 27:26; John 18:22 l Matt. Mark 14:65; 15:19]

Let the
rivers clap their hands;Let the hills be joyful together before the Lord, [Acts 2:24; [Rom. 8:32-34]]

For He
is coming to judge the earth.With righteousness He shall judge the world,And the peoples with equity. [Job 13:28; Ps. 102:26; Heb. 1:11] [Is. 51:6,]
